question: One of these words is spelled incorrectly. Which one is it?
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. rancoros .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The question asks to identify the incorrectly spelled word among the given options.
 
• The correct spelling of the word "rancoros" is **"rancorous"**.
 
• "Rancorous" means showing deep-seated resentment or bitterness.
 
• The other words:
 
 
• **Torpor:** A state of physical or mental inactivity.
 
• **Penury:** Extreme poverty or destitution.
 
• **Zealot:** A person who is fanatical in pursuit of their ideals.
 
 

Correct spelling: *"Rancorous"*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Always double-check spellings of words that sound similar but have variations in letters like "ou" or "os".
 
• Use a dictionary or spell-check tool to verify uncommon or less frequently used words.
